text_block_list.text: Upon visiting the newly opened, much-talked-about sweets cafe—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~! The special strawberry parfait here is super duper delicious!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. The smooth texture of the cream balances exquisitely with the moderate tartness of the berries.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is a special flavor fitting for our memorable 100th milestone, I believe...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu, can you not tell?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is the count of how many times Falcon-san has made a 'once-in-a-lifetime favor' to me and rewarded me in return.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing! You were actually counting? It's really been that many already~?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Initially, I never anticipated being relied upon quite so frequently, however.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco totally saw that side of Flash-san from the start, though♪ I knew you'd be a sweet, kind person...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uuu~, I messed up big time. I have to take a retake for the math test~~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Flash-san... you got almost a perfect score?! You're so good at studying!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I merely executed my study schedule for the exam scope on track; this result is simply the reflection of that.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Flash-san! Could you maybe help tutor me for the retake exam?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If Flash-san teaches me, Falco's sure she'll understand it all...! Pretty please~...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, my schedule is completely booked through the end of this month—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Can't you squeeze me in somehow?! Think of it as saving your dear roommate!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If Flash-san is ever in trouble, Falco will help you out with anything in return!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Please, please! It's the favor of a lifetime, pretty please~~!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Very well, I have no choice. ...Only this once, understood?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay, woohoo! I promise I'll treat you once we're done!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I've been relying on Flash-san right from the very start, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Looking back, that was the spark that brought us closer together, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: One could also say it was the spark that shattered all your restraint.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We became super close friends thanks to that, so let's call it a fond memory☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Besides, if a favor continues 100 times, you could practically call it a tradition, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Whether it qualifies as a tradition... I cannot say, but it is certainly something we have built together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, isn't your 'favor of a lifetime' used a bit too lightly, Falcon-san?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Should it not be reserved for more critical occasions, with someone deeply precious?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? It's not like Falco asks just anybody for a favor of a lifetime, you know!
